scope: Analytic independent derivation of the fixed-total-charge quadratic DC equations. No numerical or symbolic mathematical code executed; no DC solve or new experiment.
verdict: Proposed bordered signs/factors are correct under the stated local-field, harmonic, quadrature and gauge conventions; actual solvability and finite-amplitude bounds remain untested.

inputs.change_note: Only three comma-exponent typesetting defects corrected to intended ordinary powers; no mathematics, source or experiment changed.

conventions.mode: Real canonical perturbation A[Z Y22 exp(+iOmega t)/r+c.c.], unit mode K=A^2; dphiY=-imY, angular norm1
conventions.DC: A^2 sum_l w_l Y_l0/r, ell0,2,4; carrier omega_A=omega+A^2 deltaomega
conventions.inner_product: integral dr or dr times Euclidean array inner product
conventions.cross: N2(q+q*)-N2(q)-N2(q*), q=Z/r; both conjugate cross terms already included
conventions.a_vector: a_amp=(-G p)_amp; distinct from the action couplinga200
conventions.gauge: Amplitude-only solve requires real amplitude/pure-imaginary phase mode quadrature so DC phase force vanishes; otherwise retain static phase equations and fix U1 null direction.

analytic_checks: Carrier force derivative is -sqrt(4pi)*a_amp*deltaomega in normalized monopole coordinates
Eliminating deltaomega gives positive rank-one fixedQ operator and negative raw-charge RHS correction
Uniform-grid rank-one weights cancel; raw-charge RHS retains its1/dr factor
Local source is -Cl*r*cross(Z/r), equivalently -Cl*cross(Z)/r; no extra2
remaining_obligations: No DC inversion or solvability check performed
Parent quadrature and any discarded phase source must be checked numerically
Charge-cancellation scaling, correction norm and carrier shift require an actual declared solve
Parent oscillation frequency shift, finite-amplitude threshold control and nonlinear trajectory remain separate
No merger efficiency, galactic orbital transport or four-dwarf mass-budget closure
review_provenance: Independent analytic reconstruction of parent proposal; self-proofreading of this new derivation. File hashing only, no mathematical computation run.
